verdict.rationale: The evidence says Gitea has an API, and its API usage guide covers authentication. Its security docs mention user permission management and access control lists, and community reports note OAuth2/OIDC support. None of this documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens or credentials for an agent. User-level permission controls and identity-provider features are adjacent capabilities, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
